subject: Shared public Loop signature verification

originalClient.scope: Household reads, profile updates, invitation/removal, suspension, auth errors and exact anonymous exceptions.

rootSemanticChecks.scope: Expected error codes and status, saved profile values, invitation/removal states, suspension responses and owner/robot visibility.

verification.baseline: An incorrect secret could previously obtain ListLoops data; the new boundary rejects it.

qualifications: The original-client control uses synthetic stores and ephemeral listeners; this is not real robot deployment verification.
The three anonymous target handlers remain unimplemented; their tests verify only the exact public authentication exceptions.
Shared Loop auth does not close non-Loop authentication, full gateway policy, or full membership lifecycle parity.
Existing verifier retains source declared-body-hash semantics; this repair does not impose a new native signing protocol.
